projects.title: P2P Solar Energy Trading Platform
projects.problemStatement: The Solar Energy generated from rooftop solar panels often goes unused due to lack of efficient distribution and trading. This project aims to create a smart meter and decentralized platform for peer-to-peer trading of solar energy and introducing blockchain to handle dispute among prosumers and consumers.
projects.implementation:
Technological intervention supporting decentralized energy economy can act as a powerful growth booste by fostering local empowerment, stimulating innovation, and carrying out sustainable development. 
At IIT Bhilai, we have designed and demonstrated a prototype e-marketplace that allows secure trading of solar energy from rooftop to rooftop within the campus.
We argue that India – and the agencies and organizations operating within it – should seriously consider transitioning toward decentralized economic models, where solar energy itself could function as a form of currency. Such a paradigm shift would not only reduce dependence on centralized and non-renewable energy sources, but also align with India’s growing emphasis on energy security, and local economic empowerment. By leveraging solar energy as both a resource and a medium of exchange, India could pioneer an innovative model of sustainable development that integrates energy access, financial inclusion, and environmental stewardship.
